findings.media_retry_accounting: google.resumable_media.requests._request_helpers.wait_and_retry adds retry sleep time only; failed request duration is not subtracted
findings.metadata_retry_timeout: google.api_core.retry.retry_unary.retry_target checks deadline before retries but a running target can pass it
findings.existing_io_timeout: A requests timeout is an I/O wait bound, not an end-to-end operation deadline

decision: Hold stage 4A conditional GET/generation-bound download until a reviewed in-scope implementation preserves retry conditions and enforces total deadlines. No SDK upgrades, retry=None, transport replacement, or abandoned worker I/O added.
